brief_item.title: LMCache rc4提供MI300与MI350的ROCm兼容轮子
brief_item.core_conclusion: LMCache v0.5.3rc4发布ROCm 7.2轮子，面向AMD Instinct gfx942和gfx950，并与上游vLLM ROCm镜像的Torch 2.11、CPython 3.12 ABI匹配。它解决环境兼容问题。
brief_item.mechanism: 轮子覆盖MI300X、MI325X、MI350X和MI355X，通过expanded-assets链接配合pip --no-deps安装，目标容器为vllm/vllm-openai-rocm。
brief_item.result: 发布说明给出ROCm 7.2、gfx942、gfx950及Torch 2.11和cp312组合。文档没有KVCache吞吐、传输延迟、网络利用率或端到端测量。
brief_item.boundary: 这是release candidate的打包说明，未证明其他软件组合、多节点网络行为或性能可用。后续API和轮子稳定性仍可能变化。
brief_item.project_relevance: 它可作为MI300或MI350上开展LMCache实验的环境前置条件。验收仍需执行原生扩展检查，不能把安装成功当作网络或Token延迟收益。

facts.title: LMCache/LMCache Release v0.5.3rc3 · ROCm (gfx942, gfx950)
facts.event_hint: LMCache v0.5.3rc3 ROCm wheel for AMD Instinct gfx942/gfx950
facts.problem: AMD Instinct users need an LMCache build aligned with ROCm and the upstream vLLM ROCm container to run KV-cache experiments without ABI or dependency mismatches.
facts.mechanism: The release provides a ROCm 7.2 LMCache v0.5.3rc3 wheel for gfx942 (MI300X/MI325X) and gfx950 (MI350X/MI355X), ABI-matched to vllm/vllm-openai-rocm with torch 2.11 and CPython 3.12. The release documents pip installation with --no-deps and the versioned expanded-assets directory.

evidence.claim: A ROCm 7.2 wheel is published for LMCache v0.5.3rc3.
The wheel targets AMD Instinct gfx942 (MI300X/MI325X) and gfx950 (MI350X/MI355X), matched to torch 2.11/cp312 in the upstream vLLM ROCm image.
The documented install uses pip with --no-deps and the release expanded-assets URL inside an upstream vLLM ROCm container.

facts.evaluation_context: This official LMCache release is a packaging artifact for AMD/ROCm KV-cache infrastructure. It specifies supported architectures and software ABI targets but supplies no serving throughput, transfer latency, network utilization, or correctness measurements.
facts.limitations: The release candidate does not establish performance or compatibility outside the stated ROCm 7.2, accelerator, PyTorch, Python, and vLLM versions. Packaging alone does not show that LMCache changes KV-cache placement or network scheduling. The GitHub page contains loading-error placeholders around the short body.
facts.project_relevance: This enables reproducible LMCache deployments on MI300/MI350 hardware for later KV-cache transfer tests, but should be treated as an environment prerequisite rather than evidence of a TPN or network-performance improvement (inference).

facts.title: LMCache/LMCache Release v0.5.3rc4 · ROCm (gfx942, gfx950)
facts.event_hint: LMCache v0.5.3rc4 ROCm wheel for AMD Instinct gfx942/gfx950
facts.problem: Serving LMCache with vLLM on AMD Instinct accelerators requires a compatible ROCm build and ABI-matched dependencies; without a wheel aligned to the ROCm container, KV-cache transfer/cache experiments may fail at installation or runtime.
facts.mechanism: The release publishes a ROCm 7.2 LMCache v0.5.3rc4 wheel targeting AMD Instinct gfx942 (MI300X/MI325X) and gfx950 (MI350X/MI355X). It is ABI-matched to the upstream vllm/vllm-openai-rocm image with torch 2.11 and CPython 3.12, and installs via pip using the release's expanded-assets link without dependencies.

evidence.claim: The release provides a ROCm 7.2 wheel for LMCache v0.5.3rc4.
The wheel targets AMD Instinct gfx942 (MI300X/MI325X) and gfx950 (MI350X/MI355X).
The package is ABI-matched to the upstream vllm/vllm-openai-rocm image using torch 2.11 and CPython 3.12.
The documented installation uses pip with --no-deps and the release expanded-assets link inside an upstream vLLM ROCm container.

facts.evaluation_context: This is an official LMCache GitHub release note for an AMD/ROCm packaging artifact. It specifies supported accelerator architectures, ROCm and Python/PyTorch ABI targets, and an installation command, but reports no KV-cache throughput, latency, or end-to-end serving measurements.
facts.limitations: The release note validates packaging compatibility only; it does not show performance, correctness, multi-node networking behavior, or support for other ROCm/PyTorch/vLLM combinations. It is a release candidate (rc4), so API or wheel stability may change. The GitHub page contains loading-error placeholders around the release body, though the key package text was fetched.
facts.project_relevance: For TPN/KV-cache experiments, this lowers an AMD/ROCm integration barrier and enables reproducible LMCache test environments on MI300/MI350-class hardware. It should be tracked as an enablement dependency, not as evidence of improved network scheduling or KV-cache performance (inference).
